cohort: The study included mothers of 210 children with cerebral palsy registered in Mardin Guidance and Research Center.
finding: The primary findings revealed that most children with CP were premature, had low birth weight, had consanguineous parents, and mothers had low education and socioeconomic status, with many of these risk factors identified as preventable.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2472.5 (SD = 871.8) g; 48.1% (101) of children had a birth weight below 2500 g.
gest_age: N/A (73.3% of children were premature, but specific gestational age is not provided)
